text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to amend the existing parking regulation on the north side of Wagstaff Drive in order to provide after-hours parking opportunities for local businesses owners.
The Toronto and East York Community Council deferred consideration of the item until its June 6, 2018 meeting.
